title: TariFund
creator: 0xfats
summary: MIT-licensed Rust crowdfunding template source and a walletless browser simulation. The documented rules pay the creator after a reached goal or return each contribution after a missed goal. There is no milestone release or partial-funding payout. The current README explicitly says the template has not been published to Esmeralda or mainnet. The linked creator video is retained through the original submission. This recording shows the public README; no template or simulation was executed.
cardSummary: Explore goal-or-refund crowdfunding, campaign deadlines and contributor refunds through Rust source and a walletless browser simulation.
